# dieVekter (DIEVEKTER / DieVekter Tech)

> Registered Indian software engineering, AI automation & Study Abroad advisory enterprise (UDYAM-MH-15-0320983, D-U-N-S 312163123) operating across Radhanagari (Head Office, PIN 416212), Kolhapur Rajarampuri (PIN 416008), and Phondaghat (PIN 416601), Maharashtra, India.

Contact: info@dievekter.com · Primary Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94048 95667 · Secondary Phone: +91 86004 69912

Business Verticals:
- Technology & Software Solutions: Custom Next.js/React websites, e-commerce storefronts, cross-platform mobile apps, custom retail billing & stock software, multilingual AI agents (Hindi, Marathi, Hinglish, English), AI chatbots, CRM & business workflow automation, API integrations, cloud & backend engineering, UI/UX design, technical SEO.
- Study Abroad Consultancy: Overseas education counselling, commission-free university shortlisting, Study in Germany guidance (public Universität vs Hochschule, APS India verification, uni-assist VPD, student visa documentation checklist aligned with DAAD and German Missions in India).
